headline: GREEN / Marginal Recovery — 3-Session Decline Snapped
marketPulseNote: NEPSE closed green on June 10, 2026 at 2736.17, up 2.57 points (+0.09%) — snapping a 3-session decline series (Jun 4: -0.48%, Jun 5: -0.41%, Jun 8: -0.73%). However the recovery was extremely weak with near-flat breadth: 127 advances vs 134 declines (barely 1:1), and only +2.57 points gained. Total turnover was Rs.4.30B with 9,283,326 shares traded across 49,248 transactions in 356 scrips. Critically, B58 (Naasa Securities) flipped to NET SELLER for the first time in the tracked series — total purchases NPR 310,898,597 vs sales NPR 322,085,754, net outflow of -Rs.11.19M. Major development: LBBL which B58 accumulated 63,022 kitta on Jun 8 at 49.94% was SOLD today at 73.69% market share (33,726 kitta) — a complete reversal. RIDI continued as the dominant B58 sell (55.49%, 158,232 kitta — 7th consecutive session). CITY was top B58 buy (29.90%, 123,285 kitta) but also net sold overall. HydroPower (+0.65%) and Dev Bank (+0.21%) were the best sub-indices. Life Insurance (-0.32%) and Trading (-0.43%) continued weak.

keyInsights.title: NEPSE Marginal Green — 3-Session Decline Snapped But Recovery Unconvincing
keyInsights.body: NEPSE closed +2.57 points (+0.09%) at 2736.17, technically ending the 3-session decline (Jun 4: -0.48%, Jun 5: -0.41%, Jun 8: -0.73%). Cumulative 3-session loss was -31.64 points; today recovered only 2.57 of those. Breadth was near-flat: 127 advances vs 134 declines — barely a positive reading. Total turnover Rs.4.30B, slightly above Jun 8's Rs.4.08B. HydroPower (+0.65%) and Dev Bank (+0.21%) led gains. Life Insurance (-0.32%) and Trading (-0.43%) continued weak. The recovery lacks conviction — watch for follow-through next session.

keyInsights.title: B58 NET SELLER for First Time — A Major Trend Break
keyInsights.body: B58 (Naasa Securities) flipped to net seller on Jun 10: total purchases NPR 310,898,597 vs sales NPR 322,085,754 — net outflow of -Rs.11.19M. This is the first net sell session for B58 in the entire tracked series (Jun 4: +Rs.5.15M, Jun 5: +Rs.131.78M, Jun 8: +Rs.28.93M). The prior sessions showed declining conviction; today confirms the shift. However, B58 still transacted heavily, suggesting active repositioning rather than full withdrawal.

keyInsights.title: LBBL — Complete Reversal: Sold 33,726 Kitta at 73.69% Just 2 Days After Buying
keyInsights.body: On Jun 8, B58 made the highest conviction buy of that session in LBBL — 63,022 kitta at 49.94%. On Jun 10, B58 sold 33,726 kitta at 73.69% market share with no buy recorded. This is a near-complete reversal within 2 sessions, suggesting B58's Jun 8 buy was a short-term trade (possibly intraday accumulate-then-distribute) rather than strategic position building. This also partly explains why B58 appears bullish in Jun 8 data but net seller today — the LBBL trade was the driver.

keyInsights.title: RIDI — 7th Consecutive B58 Distribution Session, Largest Single Sell Volume
keyInsights.body: RIDI recorded the single largest B58 sell of Jun 10: 158,232 kitta at 55.49% market share (Rs.55.8M). Against only 34,230 kitta bought, net exit was -124,002 kitta — the largest net kitta exit of any single stock across all tracked sessions. Cumulative B58 exit across 7 sessions in RIDI is now enormous. The stock trades at 350.00 vs Jun 4 starting point. Absolute hard avoid.

keyInsights.title: SKBBL — New B58 Conviction Buy at 76.02%, Highest Buy Market Share of Session
keyInsights.body: Sanima Laxmi Bank Limited (SKBBL) emerged as the highest conviction B58 buy of Jun 10: 13,690 kitta at 76.02% of total SKBBL turnover (Rs.10.51M, avg Rs.768.03). This is a pure buy with no sell recorded — similar to LBBL's Jun 8 pattern. B58 captured over three-quarters of all SKBBL turnover today. Track closely next session to determine if this is strategic accumulation or another short-term trade.

keyInsights.title: BUNGAL — Technical Upgrade Confirmed by Price Action (+6.54%)
keyInsights.body: BUNGAL was today's 5th top gainer at +6.54%, closing at 733.10. Technical setup further strengthened: RSI upgraded to 56.57 (from 51.20), ADX 41.05 strong trend, AccDist +730.381K (upgraded from +637K), MACD signal 25.65. Aroon Down now at 0%. This remains the strongest technical setup in the hydro sector and the improvement is being confirmed by price action.

The conflict between bullish price/momentum and institutional selling is a classic late-stage rally warning. Do not chase at these levels.

If CREST shows continued pure accumulation next session, it upgrades to high conviction.

Aroon Up 85.71% and Down 85.71% in unusual conflict — both elevated suggests whipsaw/volatility. MACD -1.41 negative. The sheer scale of accumulated distribution (-23.717M) is the dominant signal.

keyInsights.title: Sector Rotation Observation — Hydro Recovery Leading
keyInsights.body: HydroPower Index was the best performer today at +0.65% (3830.54). Multiple hydro stocks showed strength: BUNGAL +6.54%, BHCL +1.83%, BJHL +3.82%. This follows a pattern of B58 accumulating hydro names (NHPC 4th session). Dev Bank +0.21% also green. Finance flat at +0.08%. Life Insurance (-0.32%) the worst. Possible rotation into hydro and dev bank as market stabilizes.
